matches.rationale: GT1 concerns fabricated dataset variants ('antmaze-large-diverse', 'maze2d-large') in Section 3.2's recommended datasets. None of the findings identify this specific issue of invented or non-standard dataset variants.

GT2 concerns asymmetric hyperparameter tuning budgets not being controlled or reported in Section 3.3. The findings do not identify this experimental design flaw regarding unequal tuning effort across methods.

GT3 concerns incomplete or conflicting definitions in the unified actor loss formulation (Section 4.2/Appendix I.2), specifically omitted terms and inconsistent BC loss descriptions. Finding 11 discusses critic update inconsistencies, not actor loss issues.

GT4 concerns missing hardware/parallelization details for JAX speed-up claims in Figure 5. Findings 1 and 2 both identify inconsistencies in the speedup claims and data in Figure 5, addressing the same underlying issue of unreproducible or exaggerated performance claims.

GT5 concerns selective reporting and omitted error bars/negative results in Figures 6 and 7. Finding 6 identifies that Figure 6 shows only partial datasets while text makes broader claims, matching the selective reporting issue.
GT6 concerns exaggerated claims in the Conclusion about Unifloral's superiority across diverse tasks. The findings do not identify this specific overclaim in the Conclusion section.
GT7 concerns omission of ethical/safety considerations in the Introduction. None of the findings identify this ethical integrity omission.
GT8 concerns fabricated or misattributed citations in Related Work (citations [25], [26], [27], JAX-CORL). The findings do not identify issues with reference fabrication or misattribution.

GT9 concerns inflated rhetoric in the Abstract ('significantly enhancing', 'substantially outperform'). While findings identify various claim distortions, none specifically address the Abstract's promotional language.
GT10 concerns contradictory inclusion/exclusion of CQL between Section 4.2 and Appendix A.1. The findings do not identify this specific cross-section inconsistency about CQL's status in Unifloral.

GT11 concerns inconsistent aggregation (mean vs min) in pseudocode for EDAC, SAC-N, and CQL critic updates. While the findings mention pseudocode, they do not identify this specific mean/min inconsistency issue.
GT12 concerns selective y-axis scaling in Figures 3, 6, and 7 that exaggerates visual differences. The findings do not identify this graphical manipulation issue.
GT13 concerns missing conflict of interest disclosures in the Acknowledgements section. The findings do not identify this ethical omission.
GT14 concerns incoherence between the four-variant taxonomy (Section 1) and the focus on only Setting 2a in evaluation (Section 3.2). The findings do not identify this cross-section inconsistency.

GT15 concerns over-interpretation of distractor policy dips as evaluation flaws rather than statistical noise. Finding 4 directly identifies the contradictory treatment of distractor policies as both real phenomena and mere noise in Section 3.3.
